data.body: Implementation landed for review as Gerrit change 1548 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1548). Renumbered 22 duplicate-numbered ADRs to 0070-0091 (ascending landing-date order, earliest keeps its number); added 91 per-number marker files, generated docs/adr/README.md index + RENUMBERING.md, scripts/check_adr_numbers.py (CI bijection + referential-integrity gate) and scripts/gen_adr_index.py (--check drift mode), both wired into _build-and-test.yml. Rewrote slug-bearing cross-references across docs/ and src/. Local validation: 19/19 scripts tests GREEN (happy + held-out edge), mutation check confirms the gate flags dup-number/missing-marker/dangling-ref, real-tree check exit 0, make lint + make typecheck clean, ADR-index + env-vars drift guards exit 0. Awaiting Verified +1 and LLM-Review +1.
